_comment: Inventory item recipes. An item is a SMALL COMPONENT: its own matter (composition), its own form (footprint/volume), and its own pre-installed organs — it is never merged into the host on equip, so using a knife degrades the knife, not the hand. Its stats derive from its own recipe exactly as a component's do: existence, the six channel resistances, mass, and (for the knife) a depletable sharpness from the edge material. A knife carries no organ because sharpness is a matter-derived edge quality, not a function stat. An item may also declare a `visual` block of its own - the same closed vocabulary a material uses (`VISUAL_KEYS` in src/utils/materialLook.js) - because what a garment looks like is not what the matter it is modelled from looks like: the t-shirt is red, the wood is brown. Absent means the item says nothing about its appearance; a key outside the vocabulary fails boot (and quarantines the definition when a mod carries it). An item may also declare a `consume` block - `{ targetStat: 'Group.stat', energyGain: <positive number> }` - which makes it a CONSUMABLE: the `eat` action spends the item and charges that whole-entity attribute by `energyGain`, clamped at the attribute's own `max` in data/mods/core-entity-attributes/entityAttributes.json (the same charge law as the coal burner's consumeFuelGenerateStat). `targetStat` is limited to a whole-entity resource (Physical.energy, Pleasure.pleasure); a block naming anything else, or carrying no positive amount, quarantines the definition (`src/services/ConsumableRules.js`, wiki/decisions/consumable-items.md).

powerCell.name: Power Cell
powerCell.description: Compact power source for droid systems.

coal.name: Coal
coal.description: A solid fuel chunk the M1's coal generator burns to charge its power stat — one unit of discrete, carryable fuel.

testItem.name: Test Item
testItem.description: Test item to verify inventory system functionality. Has volume=2.

testItem2.name: Test Item 2
testItem2.description: Second test item to verify inventory system functionality. Has volume=4.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: A sharp blade capable of cutting. Its sharpness is a depletable quality of the iron edge — it thins as the blade's edge matter is consumed by the cut channel.

metalBox.name: Metal Box
metalBox.description: A sturdy container for storing small items.

toolCrate.name: Tool Crate
toolCrate.description: A large wooden crate for organizing tools.

t1.name: T1
t1.description: A container weapon that fires stored items. 1 unit external footprint, 10 units internal capacity; damage is based on the volume of the consumed projectile.

tshirt.name: T-Shirt
tshirt.description: A human t-shirt. Wearable: it declares wear.minVolume = 2 (its own volume), so it fits any component that has at least 2 free volume units, no matter who (or which species) owns the component. The fit is pure volume: no named layers, no species matching. Fabric is modeled as the lightest material in this world (wood, density 0.6): 2 volume units, 1.2 mass.

knifeGenerator.name: Knife Generator
knifeGenerator.description: A self-running machine that forges one knife per turn into its own 10-slot belly, spilling the overflow onto the ground beside it. Carry it, then PLACE it in the world to run it, or RETRIEVE it to carry it again. 100% iron.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: A cold, sweet fruit. Eat it (the `eat` action) to spend the item and charge your Physical.energy by 15.

goldenApple.name: Golden apple
goldenApple.description: An apple whose skin shines like polished gold. Eat it (the `eat` action) to spend the item and charge your Physical.energy by 60.
